languageDialog.title: Choose your language
languageDialog.description: Select the language you want to use in h2l. You can change it anytime in Settings — your choice stays independent from other users.

setup.heading: Initialize your h2l instance
setup.description: Create the first administrator account, choose the default language and color palette, and optionally configure SMTP delivery.
setup.emptyDescription: No administrator account exists yet. Complete the fields below to secure and launch this self-hosted instance.
setup.alreadyInitializedMessage: Setup has already been completed. Sign in with your administrator account.

preview.title: Live theme preview
preview.description: Preview your chosen palette across Light, Dark, and High Contrast modes.
preview.sampleBody: Check contrast and readability before saving.

smtp.description: Credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-GCM. Leave unchecked to copy user activation links manually.

setup.successDescription: Your administrator account is ready. Redirecting to sign in...

login.heading: Sign in to h2l
login.description: Enter your email and password to access your workflow tasks.
login.sessionExpiredMessage: Your session expired and local offline drafts were cleared for security. Sign in again.
login.activateLinkPrompt: Received an invitation link or token?

activate.heading: Activate your account
activate.description: Set your password to activate your invited h2l account.
activate.emptyTokenDescription: No token was found in the link. Paste the activation token from your invitation below.
activate.passwordHint: Choose a password between 12 and 128 characters.
activate.successDescription: Your password is set. You can now sign in with your email and new password.

tasks.heading: Your workflow tasks
tasks.description: Complete human steps from your connected workflow engines, online or offline.
tasks.emptyDescription: When a Camunda or n8n workflow assigns a form to you, it will appear here.

feedback.claimed: Task claimed. You can now fill out and submit the form.
feedback.unclaimed: Task released back to the group queue and local draft cleared.
feedback.submitted: Form submitted successfully and local draft cleared.
feedback.queuedOffline: You are offline. Submission saved locally and queued for automatic sync.

detail.heading: Task form
detail.offlineDraftMessage: Changes are saved locally in IndexedDB until you are back online.
detail.queuedMessage: This submission is queued offline and will sync automatically when you reconnect.
detail.claimRequiredMessage: Claim this group task first to edit and submit the form.

settings.heading: Preferences
settings.description: Personalize your language, display mode, and color palette. Changes apply immediately without reloading.

language.title: Language
language.description: Independent for your current session and user profile.
language.label: Interface language

theme.title: Display mode
theme.description: Choose Light, Dark, or High Contrast mode for optimal readability.

palette.title: Color palette
palette.description: Predefined WCAG 2.1 AA color palettes verified across all display modes.

session.title: Active user profile
session.description: Switch session profile to verify independent per-user language preferences.
session.label: Profile scope

adminUsers.heading: Users & Groups
adminUsers.description: Invite team members, organize them into groups, and manage access to workflow forms.

users.title: Users
users.emptyDescription: Invite your first team member to start assigning workflow tasks.

invite.successManualLink: User invited. Copy the one-time activation link below.
invite.manualLinkDescription: SMTP is not configured. Share this one-time link with {{email}} to activate their account:

groups.title: Groups
groups.emptyDescription: Create a group to organize users for form access control and task queues.
groups.noMembersDescription: Select a user above to add them to this group.

adminProjects.heading: Projects, Processes & Access Control
adminProjects.description: Organize workflow processes into projects, define draft forms, and configure flexible ACL rules.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyDescription: Create a project to group your workflow processes.

processes.title: Workflow Processes
processes.selectProjectDescription: Choose a project on the left to view or create workflow processes.
processes.emptyDescription: Create your first workflow process inside this project.

forms.title: Draft Forms
forms.selectProcessDescription: Choose a workflow process to view or create its forms.
forms.emptyDescription: Add a draft form step to this workflow process.

acl.title: Access Control (ACL) — {{name}}
acl.description: Grant access to a whole group, narrow to specific members of a group, or assign direct users.
acl.emptyDescription: Add at least one group or user rule above, then save.

licensing.title: License & Plan Status
licensing.description: View your self-hosted Instance ID, current plan limits, and activate an offline Ed25519 license key.
licensing.keyPlaceholder: Paste your signed Ed25519 license key here
licensing.gracePeriodMessage: Your license is in a 14-day grace period (ends {{date}}). Existing tasks continue normally; renew your license to avoid creation limits.
licensing.expiredMessage: Creating new active processes and connectors is paused. Existing tasks and GDPR export/deletion continue to work.
